title: Sunday Walnut Caramels
description: A delicious and sweet treat to kick off your Sunday. Made with walnuts and gooey caramels.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spread the walnuts on the baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until fragrant.
Melt the caramels in a saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.
Remove the walnuts from the oven and let cool slightly.
Dip each walnut into the melted caramels, coating completely.
Place the coated walnuts on a piece of parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set the caramels.
